048/**
049 * SQLHoldings
050 *
051 * @author creatorfromhell
052 * @since 0.1.2.0
053 */
054public class SQLHoldings implements Datable<HoldingsEntry> {
055
056  /**
057   * The class that is represented by the O parameter.
058   *
059   * @return The class that represents the parameter.
060   */
061  @Override
062  public Class<? extends HoldingsEntry> clazz() {
063
064    return HoldingsEntry.class;
065  }
066
067  /**
068   * USed to purge the objects of this datable.
069   *
070   * @param connector The storage connector to use for this transaction.
071   */
072  @Override
073  public void purge(final StorageConnector<?> connector) {
074    //This isn't required, it'll be deleted with the account.
075  }
076
077  /**
078   * Used to store this object.
079   *
080   * @param connector The storage connector to use for this transaction.
081   * @param object    The object to be stored.
082   */
083  @Override
084  public void store(final StorageConnector<?> connector, @NotNull final HoldingsEntry object, @Nullable final String identifier) {
085
086    if(connector instanceof final SQLConnector sql && sql.dialect() instanceof final TNEDialect tne && identifier != null) {
087
088      PluginCore.log().debug("Storing holdings for Identifier: " + identifier);
089
090      sql.executeUpdate(tne.saveHoldings(),
091                        new Object[]{
092                                identifier,
093                                MainConfig.yaml().getString("Core.Server.Name"),
094                                object.getRegion(),
095                                object.getCurrency().toString(),
096                                object.getHandler().asID(),
097                                object.getAmount(),
098                                object.getAmount()
099                        });
100    }
101  }
102
103  /**
104   * Used to store all objects of this type.
105   *
106   * @param connector The storage connector to use for this transaction.
107   */
108  @Override
109  public void storeAll(final StorageConnector<?> connector, @Nullable final String identifier) {
110
111    if(connector instanceof final SQLConnector sql && sql.dialect() instanceof final TNEDialect tne && identifier != null) {
112      TNECore.eco().account().findAccount(identifier).ifPresent(account->storeHoldings(sql, tne, account));
113    }
114  }
115
116  /**
117   * Stores every holdings entry of an account in one database transaction.
118   *
119   * @return true if all entries were committed, false if nothing was saved.
120   */
121  public static boolean storeHoldings(final SQLConnector sql, final TNEDialect tne, final Account account) {
122
123    final String identifier = account.getIdentifier().toString();
124    final String server = MainConfig.yaml().getString("Core.Server.Name");
125
126    try(final Connection connection = sql.connection();
127        final PreparedStatement statement = connection.prepareStatement(tne.saveHoldings())) {
128
129      connection.setAutoCommit(false);
130      try {
131        for(final Map.Entry<String, RegionHoldings> region : account.getWallet().getHoldings().entrySet()) {
132          for(final Map.Entry<UUID, CurrencyHoldings> currency : region.getValue().getHoldings().entrySet()) {
133            for(final HoldingsEntry entry : account.getHoldings(region.getKey(), currency.getKey())) {
134              statement.setObject(1, identifier);
135              statement.setObject(2, server);
136              statement.setObject(3, entry.getRegion());
137              statement.setObject(4, entry.getCurrency().toString());
138              statement.setObject(5, entry.getHandler().asID());
139              statement.setObject(6, entry.getAmount());
140              statement.setObject(7, entry.getAmount());
141              statement.addBatch();
142            }
143          }
144        }
145        statement.executeBatch();
146        connection.commit();
147        return true;
148      } catch(final SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
149        //Runtime failures too, e.g. reading the inventory of a player who just logged out.
150        connection.rollback();
151        throw e;
152      } finally {
153        connection.setAutoCommit(true);
154      }
155    } catch(final SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
156      PluginCore.log().error("Failed to save holdings for account " + identifier + "; retrying on the next save.",
157                             e, DebugLevel.OFF);
158      return false;
159    }
160  }
161
162  @Override
163  public void delete(final StorageConnector<?> connector, @NotNull final String identifier) {
164    //nothing to do here
165  }
166
167  /**
168   * Used to load this object.
169   *
170   * @param connector  The storage connector to use for this transaction.
171   * @param identifier The identifier used to identify the object to load.
172   *
173   * @return The object to load.
174   *
175   * @throws UnsupportedOperationException as this method is not valid for holdings.
176   */
177  @Override
178  public Optional<HoldingsEntry> load(final StorageConnector<?> connector, @NotNull final String identifier) {
179
180    throw new UnsupportedOperationException("load for HoldingsEntry is not a supported operation.");
181  }
182
183  /**
184   * Used to load all objects of this type.
185   *
186   * @param connector The storage connector to use for this transaction.
187   *
188   * @return A collection containing the objects loaded.
189   */
190  @Override
191  public Collection<HoldingsEntry> loadAll(final StorageConnector<?> connector, @Nullable final String identifier) {
192
193    final Collection<HoldingsEntry> holdings = new ArrayList<>();
194
195    if(connector instanceof final SQLConnector sql && sql.dialect() instanceof final TNEDialect tne && identifier != null) {
196      PluginCore.log().debug("SQLHoldings-loadAll-Account ID:" + identifier, DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
197      try(final ResultSet result = sql.executeQuery(tne.loadHoldings(),
198                                                    new Object[]{
199                                                            identifier,
200                                                            MainConfig.yaml().getString("Core.Server.Name")
201                                                    })) {
202        while(result.next()) {
203
204          final String currency = result.getString("currency");
205
206          if(TNECore.eco().currency().find(currency).isEmpty()) {
207            EconomyManager.invalidCurrencies().add(currency);
208          }
209
210          //region, currency, amount, type
211          final HoldingsEntry entry = new HoldingsEntry(result.getString("region"),
212                                                        UUID.fromString(currency),
213                                                        result.getBigDecimal("holdings"),
214                                                        Identifier.fromID(result.getString("holdings_type")));
215
216          PluginCore.log().debug("SQLHoldings-loadAll-Entry ID:" + entry.getHandler(), DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
217          PluginCore.log().debug("SQLHoldings-loadAll-Entry AMT:" + entry.getAmount().toPlainString(), DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
218          holdings.add(entry);
219        }
220      } catch(final SQLException e) {
221        e.printStackTrace();
222      }
223    }
224    return holdings;
225  }
226}
